name: @ailm/mobile
description: Native Android/iOS shell for AI Life Manager, built with Capacitor. Wraps the live web app (www.genzylife.com) in a real app shell rather than duplicating the UI, so every feature ships to the app the moment it ships to the web — the native project here exists to unlock real device capabilities (an installable icon, native notification channels, background execution) that a browser tab can't offer.
